message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a red background. At the bottom, a stylized red car is viewed from a high angle. Its roof is stacked with beige, L-shaped and T-shaped blocks, some resembling Tetris pieces. More blocks and two blue-green dollar bills fall from the top of the frame. One dollar bill is among the falling blocks, and another sits flat atop a stack on the left. A family of three—a man in black, a woman in blue, and a child in blue—stands to the right of the car, looking upward.

The word "TEMPO" is centered in large white letters across the upper half. Smaller white text below it reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Other white text includes "Koalisi Besar Jokowi H.28" and "Tipu-tipu Biro Umrah H.50" at the top. On the right, a block of text says "LIPUTAN KHUSUS MUDIK SETELAH PACEKLIK" followed by a paragraph starting with "Pemudik tahun ini diprediksi..." and ending "di Pemilu 2024. H.60." The bottom left corner contains publishing details, including "17-23 APRIL 2023", "RP 50.000", a barcode, and a QR code.
